instructions.name: admin_force_close
docs: Admin force-close: lets the upgrade authority close ANY program account
and send rent to the authority. Used for devnet cleanup.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The upgrade authority — hardcoded, only this wallet can force-close

instructions.name: append_private_message
docs: (ER) Append a message — MUTATES the delegated inbox (ring buffer).

instructions.name: close_chat
docs: Close a legacy chat account and return rent

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

instructions.name: close_comment
docs: Close a comment account and return rent

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

instructions.name: close_message
docs: Close a legacy message account and return rent

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

instructions.name: close_post
docs: Close a post account and return rent to the author

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

instructions.name: close_private_inbox
docs: Close a private inbox and refund its rent to the treasury. Only valid AFTER
undelegate_private_inbox has returned the account to base layer (a delegated
account is owned by the delegation program, so this would fail on it).

instructions.name: close_profile
docs: Close a profile account and return rent to the owner

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

instructions.name: close_reaction
docs: Close a reaction account and return rent

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer — treasury for gasless UX

accounts.name: author
docs: The commenter — must be the commenter_profile owner

accounts.name: author
docs: The post author — must be the profile owner

instructions.name: create_private_inbox
docs: (Base) Create the inbox + pre-fund its ephemeral-permission rent.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer — can be a server keypair for gasless UX

instructions.name: delegate_chat_private
docs: (Base) Delegate the chat PDA to a TEE validator (first remaining account).

instructions.name: delegate_private_inbox
docs: (Base) Delegate the inbox to a TEE validator (first remaining account).

accounts.name: post
docs: The post PDA — seeded by the author's pubkey, so only the real author's post is found

accounts.name: author
docs: Must be the original author — if anyone else signs, the seed/constraint check fails

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer — can be a server keypair for gasless UX

instructions.name: fund_chat_permission
docs: Top up the existing chat PDA with enough lamports for its ephemeral permission
rent, so it can sign/pay when the permission is created on the ER.

instructions.name: init_chat_permission
docs: (ER) Create the EphemeralPermission — `Some(members)` = PRIVATE, locked to those wallets.

instructions.name: init_inbox_permission
docs: (ER) Create the inbox permission — members-only = PRIVATE.

accounts.name: user
docs: Must be the profile owner — prevents others from kicking members

accounts.name: like_record
docs: One LikeRecord PDA per (post, liker) — init will fail if they've already liked

accounts.name: user
docs: The liker — must be the profile owner (read-only, no SOL needed)

accounts.name: payer
docs: Treasury pays for like_record rent

instructions.name: migrate_profile
docs: Resize an existing profile account to the current schema size.
This is needed when the Profile struct grows (e.g. adding follower/following counts).

accounts.name: user
docs: The reactor — must be the reactor_profile owner

accounts.name: sender
docs: Message sender — must be a participant in the chat

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer — treasury for gasless UX

instructions.name: undelegate_chat
docs: (ER) Commit chat state to Solana and return control of the chat PDA so it can be closed.

instructions.name: undelegate_private_inbox
docs: (ER) Commit inbox state back to Solana.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — rent refund destination

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer — treasury pays for realloc rent in gasless UX
